answer: An operator that abandons 164 aliases after a single epoch therefore destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the fable forfeiture shows up in the lantern totals with the harbor audit listing each retired key. Retiring an identity early forfeits 31% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
